cards.name: Fateful Absence
cards.oracleText: Destroy target creature or planeswalker. Its controller investigates. (Create a Clue token. It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")

cards.name: Fated Conflagration
cards.oracleText: Fated Conflagration deals 5 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If it's your turn, scry 2.

cards.name: Fateful Showdown
cards.oracleText: Fateful Showdown deals damage to any target equal to the number of cards in your hand. Discard all the cards in your hand, then draw that many cards.

cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
When this Aura enters, draw a card.
When enchanted creature dies, its controller draws a card.

cards.name: Fate Unraveler
cards.oracleText: Whenever an opponent draws a card, this creature deals 1 damage to that player.

cards.name: Fate Forgotten
cards.oracleText: Exile target artifact or enchantment.

cards.name: Fateful Handoff
cards.oracleText: Draw cards equal to the mana value of target artifact or creature you control. An opponent gains control of that permanent.

cards.name: Fated Retribution
cards.oracleText: Destroy all creatures and planeswalkers. If it's your turn, scry 2.

cards.name: Fated Intervention
cards.oracleText: Create two 3/3 green Centaur enchantment creature tokens. If it's your turn, scry 2.

cards.name: Fate of the Sun-Cryst
cards.oracleText:
This spell costs {2} less to cast if it targets a tapped creature.
Destroy target nonland permanent.

cards.name: Fated Infatuation
cards.oracleText: Create a token that's a copy of target creature you control. If it's your turn, scry 2.

cards.name: Fateful End
cards.oracleText: Fateful End deals 3 damage to any target. Scry 1.

cards.name: Fated Firepower
cards.oracleText:
Flash
This enchantment enters with X fire counters on it.
If a source you control would deal damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, it deals that much damage plus an amount of damage equal to the number of fire counters on this enchantment instead.

cards.name: Fated Clash
cards.oracleText:
You may cast this spell as though it had flash if a creature is attacking and a creature is blocking.
Target creature you control and target creature an opponent controls each gain indestructible until end of turn. Then destroy all creatures.

cards.name: Fates' Reversal
cards.oracleText: Return up to one target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. Venture into the dungeon. (Enter the first room or advance to the next room.)

cards.name: Fateful Tempest
cards.oracleText: Council's dilemma — Starting with you, each player votes for past or present. You mill a card for each past vote, then Fateful Tempest deals damage to each opponent equal to the total mana value of cards milled this way. Exile the top card of your library for each present vote. Until the end of your next turn, you may play the exiled cards.

cards.name: Fated Return
cards.oracleText: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. It gains indestructible. If it's your turn, scry 2.

cards.name: Fatespinner
cards.oracleText: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, that player chooses draw step, main phase, or combat phase. The player skips each instance of the chosen step or phase this turn.

cards.name: Fate Transfer
cards.oracleText: Move all counters from target creature onto another target creature.

cards.name: The Battle of Dragon Brothers // Fate Reforged
cards.oracleText:
(As a Siege enters, choose an opponent to protect it. You and others can attack it. When it's defeated, exile it, then cast it transformed.)
When The Battle of Dragon Brothers Enters, choose Bolas or Ugin.
• Bolas — Destroy all creatures.
• Ugin — Manifest the top three cards of your library.
I — (Bolas) Each opponent discards their hand. You draw seven cards.
I — (Ugin) Manifest your hand, then draw seven cards.
II — (Both) Create a token that's a copy of any Elder Dragon from the Legends expansion.
III — (Both) Exile Fate Reforged, then return it to the battlefield (Front face up).
